steps.label: REGISTER
steps.title: Register each data set
steps.summary: Register promptly after file writing or facility delivery, before renaming, editing, converting or analysing the files.

steps.label: ADD DATA
steps.title: Add one or more registered packages
steps.summary: Prepare, upload, verify and explain one complete CAP package at a time. Repeat for every data set that belongs to the Experiment.
steps.complete_when: Every intended package shows TRANSFER INTEGRITY CONFIRMED and has an explanation.

steps.label: REVIEW & SUBMIT
steps.title: Review the Experiment and submit
steps.summary: Check every data-set card, answer the final questions and keep the Slack receipt.
steps.complete_when: Slack shows a receipt and Receipt ID.

source_paths.label: Lab instrument or your own setup
source_paths.instruction: For an instrument, custom board or software recording on your own computer, wait until writing stops and then register on that acquisition computer before the first copy whenever possible.

source_paths.label: Shared or core facility
source_paths.instruction: Keep the original delivery unchanged and register it on the first BMDL-controlled computer immediately after receipt.

all_required: All selected files belong to one scientific Experiment.
All selected files came from one instrument or source and one acquisition session.
All selected files can be explained together as one coherent data set.
rules: Different Experiment: create a different Experiment record and Capture.
Same Experiment but different instrument, source or acquisition session: create separate Captures.
Same Experiment and session but different scientific meaning: create separate Captures.
File extension alone never decides the Capture boundary.

examples.files: Raman CSV and settings from one run
Custom-board log and software metadata from one recording session
SEM images and instrument metadata from one session
Raman CSV and SEM images from the same Experiment
Fixture photographs and measurement CSV with different meanings
Similar CSV files from different Experiments

add_data_loop.later_data: Select the same Experiment. LabMate creates or resumes an append-only Additional Data submission without changing the original submission.

entry_points.desktop: The desktop application may open the secure browser uploader after a package is locally verified.
entry_points.slack: Slack may open the same LabMate registered-RAW handoff.
entry_points.credential_boundary: Google sign-in and file transfer remain in the browser; the desktop application does not receive Google credentials.

assurance: SOURCE VERIFICATION — NOT PERFORMED IN V1

faq.question: What if an instrument, custom board or my own computer recorded the data?
faq.answer: As soon as recording and file writing stop, register the unchanged files—preferably on that acquisition computer.

faq.question: What if the files came from a shared facility?
faq.answer: Register the unchanged original delivery immediately after receiving it, before changing or analysing anything.

faq.question: Which files belong in one Capture?
faq.answer: Files from one Experiment, one source and acquisition session, and one coherent data set that you would explain together.

faq.question: Can different file types be one Capture?
faq.answer: Yes, when the same acquisition produced them and you would explain them together.

faq.question: Can similar files from different Experiments be one Capture?
faq.answer: No. Similar names or extensions do not make files part of one Capture.

faq.question: Can I add several registered data sets to one Experiment?
faq.answer: Yes. Upload and explain one CAP package, then choose Add another registered package.

faq.question: Can I add data after submitting the Experiment?
faq.answer: Yes. LabMate creates a separate Additional Data submission and keeps the original submission unchanged.

faq.question: Can I start upload from the desktop application?
faq.answer: Yes. Upload this package now opens the secure browser uploader.

faq.question: Do I have to start upload from Slack?
faq.answer: No, if the Experiment record already exists. Slack and the desktop application open the same LabMate upload system.

faq.question: When am I completely finished?
faq.answer: After every package is explained, final review is submitted and Slack sends a receipt.
